headline: Indonesia Bond Auction Raises $1.14 Billion, Falling Short of Target
summary: Indonesia's recent government bond auction raised $1.14 billion, failing to reach its full fundraising target amid prevailing market conditions.
why: Sovereign bond auctions are key indicators of government borrowing costs and investor appetite for emerging market debt.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: Undersubscribed bond auctions signal higher borrowing costs or reduced appetite among fixed-income investors.
